title: Aardvark-Vanaheim Cerebus #86 May 1986 Comic Book - Dave Sim ISSN 0712-7774
descriptionText: The Aardvark-Vanaheim Cerebus #86 May 1986 comic book, written and illustrated by Dave Sim, is a vintage collectible from the Copper Age of US Comics. This issue follows the adventures of the character Cerebus in the humorous and quirky style that Dave Sim is known for. As a part of the Cerebus series, this comic book is a must-have for fans of Dave Sim's work and collectors of vintage comics.
